summary: This bill expands USDA conservation programs to promote soil health, carbon sequestration, and greenhouse gas reduction by updating definitions, broadening eligible conservation activities to include perennial production systems and agroforestry, and establishing regional agroforestry research and demonstration centers.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends existing conservation programs (Environmental Quality Incentives Program and Conservation Stewardship Program) and establishes new agroforestry centers, which would involve federal funding for these initiatives, potentially increasing government spending. It also mentions grants for agroforestry projects.
